entries.title: First Night: Dead Circuits
entries.brief: Install two fuses, throw the lever, return to the Linen Room
entries.intro: The Gloaming Ward has no power and no patience. Two fuses wait somewhere in the Infirmary. Bring the generator back, then bring yourself back.
entries.outro: The lamps along the corridors hum once and hold. Somewhere in the building, something noted exactly how you got here.

entries.title: Second Night: The Key Set
entries.brief: Gather the brass, bone and iron keys, open the Archive, take the cellar key, return
entries.intro: Alder Manor stands where the Infirmary's garden used to be. Three keys, one Archive, and a third thing that has begun to learn how you walk.
entries.outro: The cellar key is warm as a hand. Behind you the manor keeps a list of every door you opened.

entries.title: Third Night: The Cellar Gate
entries.brief: Recover the crank and the wheel, turn the gate winch, reach the stairs
entries.intro: Down. The cellar remembers the Infirmary and the Manor both. The gate at its far end will open for a crank, a wheel and a great deal of noise.
entries.outro: Light on your face, and for a moment the dark is only the dark. Umbra does not mind. It has all it needs to know about you.
